data.one_liner: An animated bottom navigation bar with a top edge that curves around a dot.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized bottom navigation bar widget where a dot glides between selected items with a curving edge. It includes optional hide-on-scroll functionality and supports item press animations.
use_when: You want a custom animated bottom navigation bar with a curved dot indicator.
You need the navigation bar to automatically hide when the user scrolls down.
avoid_when: You require standard Material or Cupertino navigation bars without custom animations.
You have more than five items in your bottom bar.
strengths: Smooth and cheap repaint-only dot animation performance.
Configurable colors, height, dot size, corner radius, and scroll-hiding behavior.
Works well with right-to-left layouts and device safe areas.
weaknesses: Limited to two to five items.
Only offers a dot indicator shape currently.
data.minimal_example:
DotCurvedBottomNav(
  selectedIndex: _currentIndex,
  onTap: (index) => setState(() => _currentIndex = index),
  items: const [
    Icon(Icons.home),
    Icon(Icons.person),
  ],
)
